title: map2d using camera based visibility
shortDescription: An endless tile map whose visible tiles follow the frustum of a perspective camera
description: A `Map2D` of 256 × 256 tiles whose visibilitor is a `CameraBasedVisibility`: it works out from the frustum of the `PerspectiveCamera` which tiles can be seen, so the map reaches out to the horizon, where fog hides its edge. A `RepeatingTilesProvider` repeats a 16 × 16 pattern of tile ids, and a `Map2DTileRenderer` with a `TileSpritesFactory` turns each visible tile into a sprite of a `TileSprites` mesh. `PanControl2D` moves the center of the map with `[W]`, `[A]`, `[S]` and `[D]`; the radio buttons hand the mouse either to the orbit controls of the camera or to the pointer panning of `PanControl2D`.
